verdict.rationale: SES documents a single SendEmail API v2 call that supports Simple, Raw and Templated messages, reachable via AWS SDKs, SMTP or direct API calls, and community users call it great for transactional email. However, sending first requires verifying an identity, and sandbox mode limits recipients to verified addresses until production access is granted, which adds real friction before a one-call send works. Missing for 10: evidence of copy-paste quickstart code, documentation of the minimal required fields, evidence that a message ID is returned for tracking, and independent hands-on corroboration of the quickstart experience.
